What it is

Static 4-slide set of polished dark-mode product UI comps (no motion): audio signal dashboard, CRM filters panel, command-K search palette, AI chat citation popover. The deliverable is pixel-faithful UI recreation.

Build prompt

Rebuild these 4 static product UI comps 1:1, pixel-faithful: dark-mode marketing screenshots of (1) an audio signal dashboard, (2) a CRM filters panel, (3) a command-K palette, (4) an AI chat citation popover. Fidelity is the deliverable - there is no motion.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - every value is plain layout/typography/CSS; recreate with your own components and assets.

## Layout
Each comp is a dark panel floating over a photographic backdrop with real backdrop blur. Comp 1 "Threshold / Signal strength": dark panel over a motion-blurred grass photo. Comp 2 "Filters": dark slide-over over a blurred warm photo. Comp 3: glassy command palette over a wheat-field photo. Comp 4: AI answer card over article text.

## Content per comp
- Comp 1: huge numerals 56.2% / 43.8%, +32% delta chip, yellow segmented progress bar with tick labels 0-100%, ACTIVE CHANNELS row with 4 small icons + "4 INPUTS" chip, corner reticle marks on the panel.
- Comp 2: search field; "User attributes" rows (Name, Email addresses x2, Status x1, Description, Company x3, Job title x5, Phone numbers) each with icon, count chip, chevron; close X top-right; Filters button + avatar above.
- Comp 3: "Search customers" input with CMD+K kbd chip; RECENT group (2 rows: avatar, presence dot, email); ALL USERS group (4 rows); footer kbd hints (# tags, arrows navigate, enter open, esc close).
- Comp 4: inline citation chips in answer text; black citation popover "Stripe Investor Letter" with quoted excerpt, "< 1 of 2 >" pager, "Page 14" and "View source" buttons; model picker "GPT 5.2" and "Add to Knowledge Base" below.

## Typography & color
Dark theme: near-black surfaces, white primary text, zinc-500 secondary, mono for numbers and kbd hints (tabular-nums), semibold titles, tight tracking on the big numerals. Glass panels: border white/10, never solid gray.

## States
Static comps. If interactive behavior is wanted, restrict it to a 120ms hover background on interactive rows.

## Don't miss
- Photo backdrops are part of the comps - panels must float over them with real blur, not flat fills.
- Corner reticle marks on comp 1 and presence dots in comp 3 are the details people notice.
- kbd chips: small radius, 1px border, mono 11px.
